name: Office in Copilot
label: Available now
what: Create and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files from inside Copilot. Files save to OneDrive with your usual permissions and labels.

name: Copilot on Windows: files and PC fixes
label: Preview
what: Ask Copilot to find, move or rename files, or to diagnose a PC problem. Arrives on Copilot+ PCs first.

name: Copilot Code
label: Early access
what: Describe a dashboard, tracker or small app in plain English and Copilot builds it. Full release planned for December.

name: Autopilot
label: Early access
what: A long-running personal agent that handles recurring tasks. You can @mention it in Teams chats and channels.

name: Copilot Workspaces
label: Early access
what: A shared space where a team and its agents work on the same project together.

name: Copilot Home
label: Rolling out
what: A start page that suggests what to work on next and opens the right agent for the job.

name: Today (Brief and Feed)
label: Private preview
what: A daily briefing in Outlook and the Copilot app. The Brief is included with Copilot; the live Feed uses Copilot Credits.

name: Fabric IQ in Excel
label: Preview
what: Ask questions of your company's governed data and build live PivotTables without leaving Excel.

name: Salesforce in Copilot
label: Preview
what: More than 38 ready-made sales skills that work on your Salesforce data inside Copilot. A Sales Cloud view in Teams is in pilot.

name: Dynamics 365 Sales and ERP plugins
label: Available now
what: Bring CRM and finance data into Copilot, Excel and PowerPoint, for example refreshing a customer deck automatically.

name: Agent 365 Business Analytics
label: Early access
what: A view of AI costs against results: task success rate, user satisfaction and hours of work assisted.

name: Agent 365 Cost Management
label: Preview
what: See what is driving AI spend, set spending policies and get alerts before budgets are blown.

name: Microsoft IQ
label: Available now
what: The context layer under Copilot, now open as a platform. Pulls from Microsoft 365, Fabric and 350+ outside tools.

name: Windows agent protections
label: Announced
what: Agents on PCs run in isolated containers, get their own identity, and follow company policies.

name: Microsoft Perception
label: Available now
what: Teams of security agents that find, defend against and fix vulnerabilities. Its triage agent handles about 80% of a typical alert queue.

name: Entra Agent ID
label: Preview
what: Every AI agent gets an identity and access rules, the same way employees do.

name: Purview protection for Copilot
label: Preview
what: Stops Copilot from using sensitive files, even ones nobody has labelled, including files attached to prompts.

name: Codename MDASH
label: Preview
what: More than 100 specialised agents that hunt for and confirm vulnerabilities in code.

name: Edge for Business: managed agent browsing
label: Preview
what: Controls for AI agents that browse the web for you, plus a skills recorder that turns a browser task into a reusable skill.

name: AI Transparency Initiative
label: Announced
what: An industry effort to agree on an open, common approach to AI transparency, security and governance.

name: MAI-Code-2 and MAI-Code-2-Flash
label: Available now
what: Microsoft's own coding models, pitched at frontier quality for a fraction of the cost. Live in GitHub today.

name: MAI-Cyber-2-Flash
label: Preview
what: A compact security model (12 billion active parameters) that powers parts of Perception.

name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
label: Available now
what: A fast, low-cost model for routing and classification, available in Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel.

name: MAI-Image-2.7
label: Preview
what: Microsoft's latest image-generation model, with a faster Flash version.

name: Foundry adds GPT-6.2 and Meta models
label: Coming
what: Foundry already lists more than 11,000 models. Nadella said OpenAI's GPT-6.2 and Meta's latest models are coming.

name: Copilot SDK 2.0
label: Available now
what: Build products on the same agent engine behind Copilot. Runs on Rust and supports six programming languages.

name: GitHub Copilot app and code review
label: Announced
what: Azure DevOps repos from clone to merge, secret detection and smarter, adjustable code reviews.

name: Maia 300 AI chip
label: Announced
what: Microsoft's in-house AI chip. Nadella said it delivers 40% more tokens per watt than leading GPU systems.

name: Cobalt 200 virtual machines
label: Available now
what: Cloud servers on Microsoft's own Arm chip, up to 50% faster than the last generation, in 20+ regions by year end.

name: Azure HorizonDB
label: Available now
what: A managed PostgreSQL-compatible database with built-in AI functions and mirroring into Fabric.

name: Power BI custom data apps
label: Preview
what: Turn a Power BI semantic model into a custom app, built in Power BI Desktop.

name: Database agents for SQL and PostgreSQL
label: Preview
what: Agents that help manage and tune databases from the new Database Hub in Fabric.

name: Cloud PCs for AI work
label: Available now
what: Windows 365 Cloud PCs with up to 32 vCPUs and GPUs for heavier AI workloads.

name: Windows Server 2028
label: Preview
what: Post-quantum cryptography, faster storage and support for running AI on your own servers.
